data.content:
## [Major quality control issues experienced with multiple L&G business orders.](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/64e03ad66b02430421356594)
Unfortunately this is the second time I had a quality control issue with a L&G purchase. I’m an interior designer, so when I purchase things for clients and projects, and the item arrives looking used or showing signs of previous use, it doesn’t reflect well on me. I purchased a lamp for my client, the lamp arrived kinda looking like it had been handled previously, which isn’t usually a big deal. A good wipe or a clean depending on what it is, usually does the trick. But I plugged this lamp into my clients electrical outlet, it pulled a large amount of power, popped the outlet and breaker and then the cord became very warm to the touch. L&G was accommodating when I reached out, offered to refund or replace, however the short caused my clinet to have to call an electrican for a service call. Just resetting the breaker cost my client more to pay an electrican to come out and service the issue, but she spent more on the electrician then we did on the actual lamp. She was pissed and I had to come out of pocket to make sure my client wasn’t feeling bad about it. 

It’s not directly L&G’s fault, but this is a major quality control issue, which IS the same type of issue I had with a previous L&G order. I’ve waisted time and money twice and it’s cost OOP expenses, so to say I’m reluctant to source from L&G as a professional for future projects is an understatement. It’s unfortunate.

August 11, 2023
